items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And, of course, Wilbur DeParis to me was a good trombone player, a very good trombone player.

ctx.x: And, of course, Wilbur DeParis to me was a good trombone player, a very good trombone player. He was a what you call all-around trombone player. Vic Dickinson. Vic Dickinson left home before I did.
